screens.name: Approach
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows consistent transition and settled compositions; supplied runtime evidence reports a 650 ms approach with immediate reduced-motion behavior.
findings: Make the automatic progression clearer because “Come closer” can suggest an action the screen does not visibly explain.

screens.name: Home — no omen
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows the dominant gold orb, explicit touch instruction, empty omen guidance and stable navigation, with responsive Home checks reported.
findings: Increase the visual presence of the small supporting instruction beneath the orb.

screens.name: Home — populated omen
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows a populated omen beneath the hero without competing with the main entry action.
findings: Give the omen slightly more separation from the raised Ask navigation orb.

screens.name: Question composer — myself, normal and large text
screens.evidence: Sheets 01 and 03 show the question-first composer, while supplied checks report doubled input text, retained questions, validation and keyboard behavior.
findings: Replace “your prediction engine” with a plain explanation of where submitted questions and answers go.

screens.name: Question composer — named person expanded
screens.evidence: Sheets 01–03 show Someone selected, an explicit first-name field and privacy guidance, with retention and first-name validation reported.
findings: Reduce the vertical gap inside the question editor so identity guidance and submission are easier to reach at enlarged text.

screens.name: Question composer — named person collapsed
screens.evidence: Sheets 02 and 18 show clean normal and 200% layouts with identity retained and the primary action visible, supported by supplied focus and retention checks.
findings: Make the collapsed identity action more explicit with a label such as “Change person.”

screens.name: Adaptive card 1 — plan
screens.evidence: Sheets 03–04 show stable question and answer placement, and supplied runtime evidence reports single advancement and focus transfer with Enter or Space.
findings: Use options that measure the same concept, since “Barely started” describes progress while “Nearly certain” describes confidence.

screens.name: Adaptive card 2 — obstacle
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 shows aligned obstacle choices and a visible step indicator with continuity between transition and settled states.
findings: Make the small step indicator easier to read without competing with the question.

screens.name: Adaptive card 3 — support
screens.evidence: Sheets 04–05 show consistent support options and the final fixture step, with answer retention on Back reported.
findings: Strengthen the visibility of the small Back control.

screens.name: Adaptive card — custom answer
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows empty normal and enlarged custom-answer states, while supplied constrained-viewport checks report long-answer editing and restored Choices focus.
findings: Rename “Choices” to “Back to choices” so its role is immediately apparent.

screens.name: Planning — loading
screens.evidence: Sheets 16–17 show the loading purpose, expected wait, credit protection and cancellation, with current reduced-motion and browser timing checks reported.
findings: Preserve this explicit wait and cancellation guidance when loading copy changes.

screens.name: Research — loading
screens.evidence: Sheet 20 distinguishes research from planning through supporting copy and reports the same cancellation and reduced-motion contracts.
findings: Quiet the large background mist shapes to maintain the loading message as the secondary focal point.

screens.name: Listening — voice unavailable
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows typing as the primary fallback, voice retry and a visible microphone failure notice.
findings: Place the voice failure explanation closer to the retry action so recovery does not require scanning to the bottom.

screens.name: Planning error
screens.evidence: Sheets 06–07 show a distinct error, no-charge reassurance, primary retry and question editing, with connection recovery reported.
findings: Specify “No reading was used” alongside retry to match the app’s visible credit terminology.

screens.name: Prediction error
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 adds answer review to the retry and edit recovery paths without presenting the failure as a completed forecast.
findings: Reduce mist contrast behind the error text to keep recovery visually calm.

screens.name: Sensitive redirect — planning
screens.evidence: Sheet 22 shows support as the primary action, alternatives and explicit no-credit/no-memory reassurance, with redirect behavior reported.
findings: Clarify the destination of “Find support near you” before the user leaves the app.

screens.name: Sensitive redirect — prediction
screens.evidence: Sheets 22–23 retain the support-first recovery structure over the prediction-stage background.
findings: Keep the support destination explanation visible alongside the primary action.

screens.name: Forecast reveal
screens.evidence: Sheets 21–22 show a strong forecast hierarchy, speculative label, date and follow-up actions, with real inference and history behavior reported.
findings: Label the date’s purpose explicitly so a forecast horizon and a check-in date cannot be confused.

screens.name: Forecast — check-in
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 shows three outcome actions beneath the forecast, and supplied current-head evidence reports persisted outcomes.
findings: Give the check-in action group stronger emphasis than sharing when a reading is being revisited.

screens.name: Forecast — outcome saved yes
screens.evidence: Sheet 15 shows a selected Yes, an inline saved result and a confirmation notice, with persistence reported.
findings: Reduce duplicate save messaging while retaining the persistent inline confirmation.

screens.name: Forecast — outcome saved not quite
screens.evidence: Sheet 15 visibly distinguishes Not quite through both a checkmark and saved text, supported by supplied outcome checks.
findings: Use the inline saved state as the durable confirmation and keep the transient notice compact.

screens.name: Forecast — outcome saved not yet
screens.evidence: Sheet 15 shows Not yet selected and a contextual pending confirmation rather than implying a successful prediction.
findings: Preserve the distinction between pending and successful outcomes in every history summary.

screens.name: Evidence overview — normal and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheets 18–21 show four clear evidence categories and enlarged reflow, with full content access and focus return reported.
findings: Correct the count label “1 scenario conditions” to use singular grammar.

screens.name: Evidence reader — answers, normal and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheets 07–08 and 17 show long answer content and enlarged heading focus, with complete scrolling content and Back focus restoration reported.
findings: Present each answer with its original question so the reader can interpret it without revisiting the interview.

screens.name: Evidence reader — assumptions, normal and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheets 08 and 17–18 show a dedicated assumptions reader with visible focus and reported complete enlarged-text scrolling.
findings: Format separate assumptions as separate readable blocks when multiple conditions are present.

screens.name: Evidence reader — reason, normal and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheets 08–09 and 19 show a full reason reader whose content and browser focus return are reported as checked.
findings: Separate recorded context, assumptions and limitations visually instead of presenting one continuous paragraph.

screens.name: Evidence reader — sources, normal and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheets 09 and 19–20 show long source links with date and publication metadata, with enlarged scrolling and sampled contrast checks reported.
findings: Put publication and date before long linked descriptions so source provenance is easier to scan.

screens.name: Free forecast — brief reason and upgrade
screens.evidence: Sheet 21 shows the reason before the Plus action, and supplied runtime evidence reports the free/Plus boundary.
findings: Name the additional evidence available with Plus rather than relying on “Go deeper.”

screens.name: Share — collapsed options
screens.evidence: Sheets 23–24 show an image preview, prominent download and explicit privacy explanation, with an actual PNG export reported.
findings: Provide an explicit “Enlarge preview” affordance because the forecast and disclaimer are tiny at this scale.

screens.name: Share — expanded invite and remind
screens.evidence: Sheets 23–24 show expanded invitation and reminder actions with privacy guidance beneath the primary export task.
findings: Expose the reminder’s destination or delivery method in its row description.

screens.name: Share — preparing export
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 shows a disabled Preparing image action, and supplied export checks report one encode for two activations while Invite stays usable.
findings: Consolidate the repeated “Preparing image” text into one clear status.

screens.name: Share — export recovery
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 shows a readable export failure and restored download action, with successful retry to an actual PNG reported.
findings: Change the restored action to “Try download again” while the failure message is present.

screens.name: Story — full image preview
screens.evidence: Sheet 25 shows the full story composition, visible speculative disclaimer and download action, with a real 1080×1920 artifact reported.
findings: Verify the exported disclaimer remains comfortably readable after common social-platform resizing.

screens.name: History — empty
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows a deliberate empty state, local-storage explanation and a direct Ask the Ball action.
findings: Give the empty-state Ask action a stronger button affordance.

screens.name: History — populated
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 separates original question, forecast and return date within a dated row, with real history creation reported.
findings: Format check-back dates in the same readable style used on the forecast screen.

screens.name: History — long list and persisted outcome
screens.evidence: Sheets 10–11 show multiple dated entries and a persistent Came true label, with current outcome persistence checks reported.
findings: Make row-opening affordance more explicit without adding heavy card borders.

screens.name: Sky — offline sample stars
screens.evidence: Sheets 24–25 show an explicit offline/sample notice, retry, selected Love star and a question-specific primary action.
findings: Increase the visible interactive area around each star while retaining the constellation arrangement.

screens.name: Circles — offline
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 shows an offline notice and Retry alongside disabled creation and consent controls; production social behavior is outside the supplied proof.
findings: Explain locally why each disabled control is unavailable instead of requiring users to connect it to the distant offline notice.

screens.name: Onboarding — age confirmation
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 shows two explicit age choices and no birthday requirement, with the under-13 gate reported but not pictured.
findings: Include the resulting under-13 state in the next evidence set to demonstrate the complete recovery boundary.

screens.name: Onboarding — birthday
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 shows a labeled date field, Continue and Skip, with invalid/valid onboarding and exact input scaling reported.
findings: State that birthday is optional beside the field rather than communicating this only through Skip.

screens.name: Onboarding — focus unselected
screens.evidence: Sheets 14–15 show four focus choices, an enabled Meet the Ball action and a separate Skip action.
findings: Clarify whether Meet the Ball without a selection has the same result as Skip for now.

screens.name: Onboarding — focus selected, normal and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 shows selection through color, underline and checkmark with clean enlarged reflow and supplied single-selection keyboard checks.
findings: Preserve the checkmark as a non-color selection cue across all focus options.

screens.name: Plans — normal and large text
screens.evidence: Sheet 16 shows yearly/monthly selection, total billing, reading packs and explicit simulation language, with simulated purchase and Restore reported.
findings: Replace “1 reading ready whenever you are” with copy that clearly distinguishes the current allowance from the Plus allowance.

screens.name: You — profile and empty memory
screens.evidence: Sheets 26–27 separate birth profile, plan and empty memory with clear edit and forget framing.
findings: Use a consistent human-readable birthday format alongside the Sun-sign summary.

screens.name: You — birthday editing
screens.evidence: Sheet 26 shows inline birthday editing with Save, Forget and Close, while supplied checks report input scaling and valid/invalid date entry.
findings: Show the birthday save confirmation and invalid-date message in the visual evidence set.

screens.name: You — optional birth details
screens.evidence: Sheets 25–26 show optional local birth time and city fields with disabled discovery actions, and real geocoding/calculation is reported.
findings: Explain that selecting a found city is required before revealing Moon and rising.

screens.name: You — settings, normal and large text
screens.evidence: Sheet 23 shows sound, motion and text-size switches with large-text navigation, supported by preference persistence, keyboard and actual animation-stop checks.
findings: Add clearer section grouping between accessibility preferences, plan actions and privacy controls.

components.name: Hero orb
components.evidence: Home uses a dominant gold orb while other stages use smaller supporting orbs, with clipping, draw timing and reduced-motion behavior reported.
findings: Keep an explicit adjacent action label wherever the orb is interactive.

components.name: Tab bar
components.evidence: Home, Sky, History and You show consistent labeled navigation with a raised Ask orb and active gold underline.
findings: Increase normal-size label readability and document measured hit areas for every tab.

components.name: Wordmark and balance header
components.evidence: The sheets consistently separate the wordmark or screen title from allowance and test-plan status.
findings: Include the noun “reading” in the allowance label when space permits.

components.name: Primary button
components.evidence: Cream buttons remain prominent across forms, recovery and sharing, with visible disabled export state and supplied activation checks.
findings: Retain the consistent loading and disabled treatment across every asynchronous primary action.

components.name: Secondary action
components.evidence: Secondary actions vary between centered gold text, white divided rows and inline links across the supplied screens.
findings: Standardize secondary navigation and secondary commands into distinct, consistent treatments.

components.name: Answer choice
components.evidence: Answer rows have generous spacing and supplied evidence reports single keyboard advancement, retained answers and focus transfer.
findings: Preserve the full-row activation area and immediate selection feedback.

components.name: Question input
components.evidence: Sheets 01–03 show a labeled multiline editor with reported four-line capacity, question retention and browser keyboard checks.
findings: Simplify the outlined focus treatment so the outer rectangle and inner baseline do not look like two competing boundaries.

components.name: Large-text input
components.evidence: Large composer and custom-answer views visibly reflow, with exact doubling and constrained-viewport editing reported.
findings: Retain the question label while minimizing decorative header space at enlarged sizes.

components.name: Settings switch
components.evidence: Sheet 23 shows clear on/off switch states, and supplied checks report labeled row activation, keyboard focus, persistence and actual motion stopping.
findings: Maintain the whole labeled row as the operable target at both text sizes.

components.name: Omen content
components.evidence: Sheets 11–12 show populated and empty omen content with explicit free status and useful empty guidance.
findings: Increase separation from the bottom navigation without reducing the omen text size.

components.name: Sky star and selected question
components.evidence: Sheets 24–25 link a checkmarked Love star to a labeled sample question and Ask this too.
findings: Make each star’s touch area visually discoverable without relying on the small decorative glyph.

components.name: Circle surface
components.evidence: Sheet 06 explains invitation privacy while showing offline recovery and disabled creation and consent controls.
findings: Place a concise unavailable reason next to the disabled create action.

components.name: History row
components.evidence: Sheets 10–11 show question, forecast, date and persisted outcome within restrained separated rows.
findings: Add a quiet opening cue and use readable date formatting consistently.

components.name: Plan option
components.evidence: Sheet 16 displays selected yearly billing with a checkmark, annual total, monthly equivalent and enlarged reflow.
findings: Keep total billed amount visually adjacent to the selected plan at every text size.

components.name: Share preview
components.evidence: Sheets 09–10 and 23–25 show a small portrait preview and a separate readable full-size story view, with actual export reported.
findings: Add a clearly labeled enlargement action and accessible text equivalent for the small preview.

components.name: Notice and recovery
components.evidence: Voice, export and outcome states show readable notices and explicit recovery, with browser recovery and persistence checks reported.
findings: Place notices closer to their triggering controls and document live announcement behavior separately.

components.name: Typography system
components.evidence: Display serif and practical sans-serif roles are consistent, while normal metadata and miniature preview text remain visually small.
findings: Increase secondary-text comfort and break long evidence paragraphs into clearer sections.

components.name: Atmospheric background
components.evidence: Mist remains coherent across stages, with supplied settled/transition contrast, clipping and actual reduced-motion checks.
findings: Reduce the prominence of large smoky shapes behind evidence and forecast text.

components.name: Birthday input
components.evidence: Sheets 13 and 26 show explicit ISO-format entry and inline editing, supported by reported validation and scaling checks.
findings: Provide a human-friendly date-entry affordance while preserving a clearly labeled manual format.

components.name: Age confirmation
components.evidence: Sheet 13 shows an unambiguous age question and two explicit answers, with the under-13 boundary reported.
findings: Add visual evidence of the under-13 result before treating this boundary as fully reviewed.

components.name: Focus selection
components.evidence: Sheets 14–15 show unselected and selected focus rows with checkmarks and enlarged reflow, supported by keyboard selection checks.
findings: Preserve explicit single selection and the non-color selected cue.

components.name: Birth-profile surface
components.evidence: Sheets 25–27 separate Sun sign, age band, birthday and editing actions within a borderless profile section.
findings: Capitalize the Sun-sign name and display the birthday in a readable localized format.

components.name: Birth-details form
components.evidence: Sheets 25–26 show optional time/city fields and disabled dependent actions, with real lookup and calculated details reported.
findings: Explain the lookup-and-select sequence before the dependent Reveal action.

components.name: Named-person control
components.evidence: Sheets 01–03 show expanded and collapsed identity states with name and privacy guidance, supported by validation and question-retention checks.
findings: Use “Change person” as the disclosure action to make its purpose more explicit.

components.name: Evidence disclosure and reader navigation
components.evidence: Sheets 17–21 show category rows, reader headings and Back links, with complete content and keyboard focus restoration reported.
findings: Keep Back to all evidence and Back to forecast visibly distinct throughout long readers.

components.name: Export status
components.evidence: Sheets 09–10 and supplied export checks demonstrate pending disablement, duplicate-activation protection, recoverable failure and successful PNG retry.
findings: Verify status announcements for assistive technology and remove duplicate preparing text.

components.name: Forecast presentation
components.evidence: Sheets 06 and 21–22 show a prominent prediction with speculative confidence and an ambiguously labeled By date.
findings: Separate the forecast horizon from the reminder or check-in date through explicit labels.

components.name: Outcome selector
components.evidence: Sheets 06 and 15 show three distinct outcomes, checkmarked selection and inline saved status, with all three persistence paths reported.
findings: Give each outcome a more recognizable selectable control boundary.

components.name: Custom-answer editor
components.evidence: Sheet 05 shows the persistent question and disabled empty-state Continue, with long editing, constrained-height layout and focus return reported.
findings: Replace the terse Choices link with an explicit return-to-options label.

limitations: All grades are provisional browser grades based on the attached sheets and supplied runtime account; no files, source, previous ratings or live application were inspected.
The browser A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met across every screen and component; strong runtime evidence does not remove visible clarity, typography and hierarchy issues.
A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; overall is 0.4A + 0.6F, rounded to one decimal, excluding genuinely inapplicable dimensions.
Corresponding transition images were assessed with settled states, but still frames cannot independently establish temporal continuity, press feedback or absence of layout shifts.
Reported browser checks support behavior scores but were not independently rerun; screenshots alone do not prove target dimensions, keyboard operation, announcements or complete scrolling access.

Below-fold content in enlarged and scrolled screenshots was not treated as unreachable because supplied checks report scrolling and reachable controls; clipped viewport edges alone do not establish a hard-gate failure.
No hard-gate failure is established by the supplied material, and fixture wording, long synthetic content and fixture date inconsistencies were not treated as evidence of production model defects.
Physical iPhone Safari, native Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, real microphone, haptics, payment processing and OS sharing remain unverified; browser scores of 9 do not certify native quality.
The pictured Circles state is offline; supplemental social verification does not certify production authentication, social services or native geolocation.
No representative novice-use study, predictive-accuracy evaluation or broad semantic-quality evidence was supplied.
topFixes: Label forecast horizon and check-in dates distinctly so the displayed date has one clear meaning.
Make small share previews explicitly enlargeable and provide an accessible text equivalent.
Structure evidence readers into scannable context, assumptions, limitations and source provenance without removing content.
Clarify terse actions and disabled dependencies: Change person, Back to choices, support destination and birth-city selection.
Improve small secondary-text readability and quiet mist behind text-heavy screens.
Consolidate duplicate status messages and place recovery explanations near their controls.
